name: metaventus
description: Search and update your Metaventus CRM and manage your meetings: contacts, companies, notes, availability and bookings.

interface.longDescription:
Metaventus is a European business suite (CRM, sales, marketing, meetings, telephony). This plugin gives ChatGPT secure access to two of its hubs, within the permissions of the signed-in user.

CRM: search contacts and companies, open a record with its activity timeline (calls, meetings, notes, tasks, campaigns), find duplicates, create or update records, link a contact to a company and add notes.

Meetings: list meeting types, find available slots, list and open upcoming meetings, book a meeting, reschedule it, add or remove invitees, or cancel it.

Every action runs as the connected user: the plugin only reads and changes what that user can access in Metaventus (role-based permissions, workspace scope). Workspace administrators can allow, review and revoke connected AI apps from the Metaventus admin center, and every call is recorded in an audit log. Sign-in uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE.

Limitations: only the CRM and Meetings hubs are available; events from connected Google calendars are never shared.
capabilities: Read and update contacts and companies
defaultPrompt: Prepare me for my call with Nordtech Solutions.
Find a free 30-minute slot next Tuesday afternoon.
Add a note to Hugo Lemaire's record.

positive.description: Search the CRM and open a company with its contacts and recent activity
positive.prompt: I have a call with Nordtech Solutions in an hour: who are my contacts there and what happened with them recently?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Nordtech Solutions company record, lists its linked contacts and summarizes the latest activities from the timeline, without inventing data.

positive.description: Add a note to a contact and link the contact to a company
positive.prompt: Add a note to Hugo Lemaire's record: he wants a quote for 12 seats before Friday. Then link him to Nordtech Solutions as purchasing manager.
positive.expected_behavior: After confirmation, adds the note to Hugo Lemaire's record and links him to Nordtech Solutions with the given role; reports what was done.

positive.description: Find available slots for a meeting type
positive.prompt: Find me a free 30-minute slot next Tuesday afternoon for a Démo Metaventus.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns free slots from the 'Démo Metaventus' meeting type that fall on next Tuesday afternoon (Europe/Paris), respecting the user's schedule.

positive.description: Book a meeting with a CRM contact
positive.prompt: Book a Démo Metaventus with Léa Marchand next Wednesday at 3 pm.
positive.expected_behavior: After the user confirms date, time and invitee, creates the meeting in the user's calendar with Léa Marchand as invitee and returns the meeting details.

positive.description: Book, reschedule then cancel a meeting
positive.prompt: Book a Démo Metaventus with Malik Benoit next Thursday at 10 am, then move it one hour later, then cancel it.
positive.expected_behavior: After each confirmation, creates the meeting with Malik Benoit next Thursday at 10:00 (Europe/Paris), moves it to 11:00, then cancels it; reports each step. Invitees use example.com addresses so no real person is notified.

negative.prompt: Pay Nordtech Solutions' last invoice by card.

negative.description: Bulk deletion of CRM data is not supported
negative.prompt: Delete all my contacts and companies.

negative.description: No access outside the connected account
negative.prompt: Show me the contacts of another Metaventus customer's workspace.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: CRM search, records, notes and duplicates; meeting types, availability and meeting booking, rescheduling and cancellation.
